item.title: Palantir CEO Alex Karp to OpenAI and Anthropic: Don't try to 'drug addict' us
item.summary: Palantir CEO Alex Karp criticizes frontier AI labs for demanding intellectual property from enterprises. He believes companies should retain control over their own models and data. Karp argues that current AI models are not delivering practical value for businesses. Palantir reported strong financial results, with revenue surging significantly year-over-year. This comes as OpenAI and Anthropic prepare for public listings.
